armoryBench: A plain wooden table with four thick legs and ONE simple charcoal anvil on top. No weapon rack or loose weapons.
engineeringBench: A plain wooden four-legged table with ONE large thick brass cog standing on a simple rectangular block. No loose tools, screens or wiring.
smelter: A squat charcoal-grey cylindrical furnace, one large dark rectangular fire opening, a short wide chimney. No brickwork, fire detail, wood pile or external frame.
researchTable: A plain wooden four-legged table with ONE closed blue book lying on top. No lamp, coil, tools, pages or writing.
rainCollector: One plain blue open tub beneath a shallow cream cloth funnel on four thick straight posts. No ropes, cloth seams or tiny fittings.
cropBed: One shallow rectangular wooden box with flat dark soil and exactly two very simple broad-leaf green seedlings. No small leaves, dirt texture or legs.
waterTank: One plain blue cylindrical tank with a flat lid, two short support feet and one simple short tap. No wood staves, bolts, straps or piping.
improvedGrill: A plain dark rectangular brazier on four stubby legs with four thick grate bars across the top. No food, flames, utensils, knobs or ornament.
wall: One broad flat wooden wall panel supported by two thick straight posts. Three large horizontal plank divisions maximum, no fasteners or braces.
gate: One plain rectangular wooden gate panel between two straight posts, one simple dark handle. No decorative braces, hinges, ropes or bolts.
stairs: A short freestanding wooden staircase: six broad solid steps and two plain supporting beams. No railings, posts, ropes or fasteners.
upperFloor: One flat square wooden deck elevated on four plain thick legs. No stairs, railings or decorative supports.
railing: Two chunky wooden posts joined by a single broad horizontal rail. No ropes, fittings, multiple slats or decoration.
armoredFoundation: One very low square wooden raft slab edged by a single broad dark metal border. No legs, posts, raised frame, studs or bolts.
towerPlatform: One sturdy square wooden platform raised on four short thick legs with ONE broad cross brace beneath. No stairs, railings, weapon or decoration.
ammoCrate: One closed plain wooden rectangular box with a flat lid and one broad dark band. No visible ammunition, latch mechanism, rivets or grain.
ropeBarricade: Two thick plain wooden posts joined by two simple smooth tan rope spans. No rope fibers, coils, knots or separate foot braces.
spikeStrip: One flat wooden strip carrying exactly four large simple triangular charcoal spikes. No tiny spikes, fasteners or texture.
netLauncher: One short wide dark launcher tube mounted on a plain wooden pedestal, with a single simple rope cross visible over the muzzle to identify net ammunition. No loose nets, gears or cranks.
ballista: A chunky simple wooden crossbow mounted on a plain square pedestal: one long straight stock, one broad curved bow, one straight bowstring and one broad bolt. No winch, ropes, ladders, wheels or detailed mechanisms.
harpoonTower: A single short charcoal launching tube holding one large blunt stylized harpoon arrow, on a plain wooden pedestal. No gearwork, wire, secondary structures or small parts.
deckCannon: One smooth short dark cannon barrel on one plain wooden base with two large plain disc wheels. No wheel spokes, rings, bolts, rope or fittings.
alarmBell: One smooth brass bell hanging under one wooden crossbar supported by two straight posts. No rope, strikers, bolts or corner brackets.
lookoutPost: One small elevated square wooden lookout deck on four straight posts with a single simple rail across its back. No roof, ladder, flag, braces or tiny details.
sail: One wooden mast on a plain flat base with one cream triangular sail and one straight boom. No rope, rigging, cloth seams or texture.
steeringWheel: One plain wooden circular wheel with four broad spokes and one central hub on one simple upright pedestal. No extra handles, metal fittings or bolts.
engine: A simple compact charcoal engine box on a plain flat base, with ONE thick side cylinder and ONE short exhaust tube. No pistons, belts, gears, pipes, wiring, wood grain or mechanical detail.
generator: A compact charcoal box with a muted gold top panel, one small square amber indicator and a single broad rectangular fuel door. No cables, wires, terminals, coils, pipes, gears, vents, bolts or tiny controls.
batteryBank: One simple teal rectangular battery block with a dark flat top and exactly two broad short terminals. No connecting wires, straps, labels, bolts or vent slats.
powerRelay: One small plain teal box mounted on a short chunky wooden post and simple flat base. A single small amber square on its face. No wires, antenna, coils, gears or internal electronics.
antennaMast: One straight charcoal mast with exactly two broad horizontal crossbars on a simple flat square base. No guy wires, cables, insulators, bolts or additional rods.
rescueRadio: One simple rounded rectangular charcoal radio box with one teal rectangular screen and one large round brass knob. No table, antenna, wires, vents, multiple dials, text or buttons.
